summary: This EverGreen Horizons welcome note sets out the company's commitment to diversity and inclusion. It introduces the "Growth Without Boundaries" training and professional development program, which includes mentorship pairing seasoned professionals with early-career staff. The company pledges equal access to all programs, removal of participation barriers, and quarterly success stories from employees.
one_line: EverGreen Horizons outlines its diversity and inclusion commitment, centered on the "Growth Without Boundaries" training and mentorship program with equal access for all employees.
key_facts: EverGreen Horizons states that its strength lies in the unique perspectives and experiences of its people.
The company's latest initiative is a program called "Growth Without Boundaries."
"Growth Without Boundaries" is designed to empower each member of the EverGreen Horizons family through continuous learning and skill enhancement.
EverGreen Horizons offers comprehensive training and professional development opportunities catering to the diverse needs and aspirations of its workforce.
Each quarter, EverGreen Horizons shares success stories from team members who excelled through its professional development programs.
The "Growth Without Boundaries" program includes mentorship schemes pairing seasoned professionals with those in the earlier stages of their careers.
EverGreen Horizons says mentorship fosters diverse thinking, innovation and mutual understanding.
EverGreen Horizons pledges to provide equal access to all training and development programs.
The company says it actively removes barriers to participation so employees from all backgrounds can benefit and advance in their careers.
EverGreen Horizons views diversity as a source of innovation, creativity, and competitive advantage.
The company calls its people its "most valuable asset."
The note's stated aim is a future where "every voice is heard, encouraged, and celebrated."
